cases.description: No picks: the base wins on cook count (5 vs 2, 1, 2).
Pinning the 300 g cream leaves only variant A.
Pinning the added pepper leaves only B; the added ingredient is listed after the base rows.
Pinning the swapped product leaves only C.
A pin shared by base and B keeps both compatible; base wins on cook count.
Pins taken from A and B: no variant has both, so it is a custom mix; A matches as many pins as B and has the higher cook count.
Pins from C and B: custom mix, C wins the tie on cook count (2 vs 1).
Custom mix, equal pin matches: the favourite B beats A.
Three pins, no variant has all: D matches two of them and beats A and B (one each) despite fewer cooks.
Remembered auto picks (A) keep the choice although the new variant D has a higher cook count.
The same matrix without memory: D wins on cook count.
The favourite A (2 cooks) beats the base (5 cooks).
Equal cook counts: the preference for P2 to P3 lifts C above the base.
The preference score ranks above the cook count.
A favourite outranks the preference score.
Weights of all swaps of a variant add up; unrelated preferences are ignored.
Remembered picks matching B outrank the favourite A.
Without any other signal the highest cook count wins.
All signals tied: the base comes first.
Cook counts tied between A and C, pin "none" on the added slot: the older A wins over C.
The same with C created before A: C wins.
Pinning "none" on the added slot keeps base, A and C and leaves the ingredient out.
Only chosen non-none options are listed, added ones after the base rows.
No pins and the base wins: no added ingredient is listed.
Compatible options first, then by support count, then matrix order.
Everything compatible: support count decides, ties keep the matrix order.
Picks for an unknown slot or option (a deleted variant) are dropped.
A user pin on A; the remembered auto pick on another slot does not override the best variant.
A recipe without visible variants resolves to the base.
The picked option is marked selected with its source.
T00 matrix: the base has more cooks than the variant.
T00 matrix: pinning 300 ml selects the variant.
T00 matrix: a preference for the swap lifts the variant above the base despite fewer cooks.
T00 matrix: pinning "none" on the onion selects the variant that removes it.
T00 matrix: all tied, the base comes first.
T00 matrix: pinning the added pepper lists it after the base rows.
